validation.invalidEmail: Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com
validation.invalidPhone: Enter a valid phone number, digits only, like 98765 43210
validation.panShape: Enter the 10-character PAN, like AABCV1234F (5 letters, 4 digits, 1 letter)
validation.udyamShape: Udyam number should look like UDYAM-TN-02-0012345
validation.gstinCheckDigit: This GSTIN doesn’t look right. Check each character against your GST certificate.
validation.hsnRequired: Add the HSN (goods) or SAC (services) code. A GST-registered business must give one.
validation.hsnShape: The HSN/SAC code must be 4, 6 or 8 digits, like 9983
validation.taxRateDecimals: A rate can have at most three decimals
validation.tanShape: Enter the 10-character TAN, like CHED12345A (4 letters, 5 digits, 1 letter)
validation.ifscShape: Enter the 11-character IFSC, like HDFC0001234 (4 letters, a zero, then 6 letters or digits)
validation.pincodeShape: Enter a six-digit PIN code, e.g. 400001
validation.pincodeState: PIN code {{pin}} is in {{pinState}}, not {{state}}. Check the PIN code or the state.
validation.gstinRequiredForType: This party is GST-registered, so enter their 15-character GSTIN
validation.gstinNotForType: Remove the GSTIN, or change the party type to registered. Unregistered and overseas parties don’t have one.

remote.noUploadUrl: We couldn't start the upload. Check your connection and try again.
remote.uploadFailed: The upload didn't go through. Check your connection and that the file isn't too large, then try again.
remote.incompleteSession: We couldn't keep you signed in. Please sign in again.
remote.noPdf: We couldn't prepare the PDF. Try again, or contact support if it keeps happening.
remote.noLink: We couldn't create the link. Try again, or contact support if it keeps happening.
remote.exportSlow: The export is taking longer than expected. Try again shortly.
remote.exportFailed: The export didn't finish. Try again, or contact support if it keeps happening.
remote.portalOffline: Connect to the internet to reach the GST portal, then try again.
remote.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
remote.noPermission: You don't have permission to do this. Ask the business owner or an admin.
remote.notFound: We couldn't find that. It may have been deleted. Refresh and try again.
remote.conflict: This clashes with something already saved. Refresh and try again.
remote.changedElsewhere: Someone else changed this just now. Reload to see the latest, then try again.
remote.checkDetails: Some details aren't valid. Check what you entered and try again.
remote.tooLarge: That file is too large. Choose a smaller one and try again.
remote.tryLater: We couldn't complete this right now. Please try again in a few minutes. If it keeps happening, contact support.
remote.earlierFailed: Not saved, because an earlier change couldn't be saved. Fix that one first.
remote.notSavedYet: This document hasn't been saved yet: {{reason}}
remote.stillSaving: This document is still being saved. Try again in a moment.
remote.imageUploadFailed: The image couldn't be uploaded. Use a PNG or JPEG image under 5 MB and try again.
remote.imageGone: The picked image is no longer available. Please choose it again.
